prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person in a long black coat with a shiny, dark pattern and black pants"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P02","P03","P04","P05","P06","P07","P08"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"All individuals wear long black coats with a shiny, dark pattern (appearing as a camouflage or abstract design) and black pants. The coat length, pattern, and pants are consistently visible across all tiles, satisfying the full appearance description for every person."}

parsed.reason: All individuals wear long black coats with a shiny, dark pattern (appearing as a camouflage or abstract design) and black pants. The coat length, pattern, and pants are consistently visible across all tiles, satisfying the full appearance description for every person.
